rows.name:
I found a Cubic Diamond in a storage
warehouse at the old factory.

rows.label: tlk45100152_03_msg0002
rows.name:
I gave it to my mom as a present, but
she slapped me... Said I shouldn't be
going to such dangerous places.

rows.label: tlk45100152_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Then she praised me, saying I'm brave
and kind, like Emperor Nefer.

rows.label: tlk45100152_03_msg0004
rows.name:
All right! Next I'll go to the Old
City of Elgria and get an Amber Leaf!
